description: This file implements the DisplayInfo plugin for WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and system information retrieval related to display and connection properties.

classes.name: DisplayInfo
classes.description: A class implementing the display information plugin, handling initialization, request processing, and system info retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up connection and display properties interfaces, and registers necessary components.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters components, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information; currently empty.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently does nothing.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, supports GET to return display info in JSON format.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Populates display information such as GPU RAM, connection status, resolution, HDCP, and HDR settings.
